'''Nick Archa''' (also published as '''Nick Arca''') is a Star Wars CCG player. He finished 24th at [[2001 Georgia State Championship]] on 5 May 2001, according to Charlie Herren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2248">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-06-wal-mart-stickers-and-the-anti-drawd2248/ wal-mart-stickers-and-the-anti-draw], DeckTech (Charlie "Bad Player" Herren, 6 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-06-wal-mart-stickers-and-the-anti-drawd2248/ GitHub Pages].</ref> At the [[June 2001 Columbia tournament]] in Columbia, South Carolina, on 30 June 2001 he played [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYCFA Ties]] and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|HB Xwings]], according to Paul Myers's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2554" />
